origin: Own exact dimensionless three-bar thermoelastic-perfectly-plastic specimen. Loads, thermal strains and geometry are prescribed mathematical controls, not measurements of a named alloy or a pressure vessel. No creep, damage, hardening, fracture, chemical reaction or temperature-dependent yield stress is present.
mechanical_model: Three parallel bars of equal unit area and length are attached to rigid plates, so they have one common axial total strain epsilon. Each modulus E_i=1 and tensile/compressive yield stresses are+1/-1. Each constitutive law is sigma_i=epsilon-theta_i-p_i, where theta_i is the prescribed thermal strain and p_i the signed plastic strain. Static equilibrium is sigma1+sigma2+sigma3=P, with constant tensile total force0<P<3. This is total FORCE, not per-bar stress. Small-strain quasistatic response and associated rate-independent perfect plasticity apply: |sigma_i|<=1; plastic flow is zero in the interior, nonnegative at+1, nonpositive at-1, with complementarity. There is no arbitrary clipping of stresses followed by a violation of force equilibrium. Initially theta=(0,0,0), p=(0,0,0), sigma=(P/3,P/3,P/3), epsilon=P/3, after an elastic mechanical preload.
thermal_history: One cycle is the directed triangular thermal-strain path v0=(0,0,0)->v1=(Theta,0,0)->v2=(0,Theta,0)->v0, each edge traversed linearly in a unit parameter interval. The load is held fixed throughout. Repeat this SAME directed cycle indefinitely. Bars1,2are heated in this order; bar3thermalstrain stays zero. Time merely parametrizes a rate-independent path. Reversing the cycle, resetting plastic strains after each cycle or heating the bars independently under separate force controls changes the experiment.
static_elastic_adaptation_problem: First characterize all amplitudes Theta>=0 for which ONE time-independent self-equilibrated residual-stress vector r with sum r_i=0 can keep the entire elastic stress field inside the yield interval for EVERY point of the thermal triangle. The elastic field is sigma_el=P/3*ones+mean(theta)*ones-theta. Require |sigma_el_i(theta)+r_i|<=1 everywhere. Infer the complete piecewise static feasibility limit as a function of0<P<3, including the branch intersection and non-strict feasible boundaries. Prove necessity AND sufficiency, not just optimizer samples. Retain full registered linear-program outputs maximizing Theta jointly with the three FREE residual-stress components for each P in[1/2,1,3/2]. These programs must include BOTH yield signs at EVERY vertex and the residual self-equilibrium equality, with Theta>=0. Do not accidentally constrain residual stresses to be nonnegative; a solver-selected nonunique residual witness is not a unique physical answer. Explain exactly why vertex checks suffice on the continuous triangle. Separately derive the largest virgin amplitude with NO plastic flow under the zero residual initial condition; it need not equal the adaptation limit.
actual_elastic_field_evidence: Retain actual registered matrix multiplication of the FULL projector ones*ones^T/3-I3with the COMPLETE3x3thermal vertex matrix whose columns are v0,v1,v2 for each of the four prescribed cases below, then add the common P/3mechanical field. At each case initial state and each of the first two cold cycle endpoints, verify the full four-unknown stress/compatibility problem with a registered linear-system solve: unknowns(sigma1,sigma2,sigma3,epsilon), equations sigma_i-epsilon=-theta_i-p_i and sum sigma_i=P. The endpoint RHS must use that case actual retained evolved plastic strains and theta0, not reset them. Retain full outputs; identical physical states may share one solve if their identity is explicit.
history_solution_and_verification: For EACH case integrate the actual quasistatic constitutive/force system over the first TWO complete cycles, retaining every yield/unloading transition or an independently verified equivalent exact piecewise path. Report the complete cold stresses, common strains and dissipations for both cycles. Numerical stepping alone may serve as a cross-check, but an endpoint clip, a coarse grid, static infeasibility or a finite apparent transient cannot certify infinite-cycle behavior. On a segment with a fixed plastic active set, sigma_dot=0 on flowing bars; force equilibrium determines epsilon_dot as the mean theta_dot over elastically responding bars; then sigma_dot_i=epsilon_dot-theta_dot_i on elastic bars and p_dot_i=epsilon_dot-theta_dot_i on flowing bars. Determine which yielded bars unload at a vertex and certify all flow signs and complementarity. Derive the actual cold-to-cold cycle recurrence or translation and the limiting behavior for each case. State whether plastic flow stops after finitely many cycles, decays with finite cumulative dissipation, persists in a bounded periodic plastic cycle, or causes a nonzero common-strain increment each cycle. Use the requested labels elastic/asymptotic_elastic_shakedown/alternating_plasticity/ratcheting in case orderE,S,A,R. A periodic stress alone is insufficient for this decision.
infinite_cycle_outputs: For caseS give the exact cold-state limit of stress, plastic strain and common strain, its nonzero recurrence relaxation factor, and TOTAL plastic dissipation summed over all cycles INCLUDING cycle1. Determine whether flow actually vanishes after a finite number of cycles, rather than merely becoming numerically small. For caseA give the periodic cold stress and plastic state, net common-strain increment per period and strictly nonnegative dissipation per period. For caseR give periodic cold stresses, the asymptotic common and each bar plastic strain increment per period, plus dissipation, mechanical work and thermal work per period. Establish these claims by the full return map, not a guessed extrapolation.
energy_accounting: Stored elastic energy is U=1/2 sum sigma_i^2. Mechanical work on the bars is integral P d epsilon. Thermal generalized work on the bars is -sum integral sigma_i d theta_i; theta is a controlled eigenstrain, not an external body force. Plastic dissipation is sum integral sigma_i d p_i, equal to accumulated absolute plastic-strain variation because the yield magnitude is1, NOT the absolute value of each bar net plastic increment. Verify W_mechanical+W_thermal=DeltaU+D for every piecewise segment and complete cycle, preserving signs. A periodic stress means DeltaU=0, but may coexist with either positive dissipation at zero net plastic strain or unbounded accumulated deformation.
scope: The global static feasibility problem supplies a history-independent elastic adaptation certificate for this load domain. A failure of that certificate does not by itself identify which failure mode occurs for every possible history. Infinite-cycle conclusions for E,S,A,Rmust come from their specified directed path and associated flow. Closed static yield feasibility and strict absence of plastic flow are different conditions; do not label every boundary contact as finite plastic dissipation. These ideal specimen conclusions are not fatigue life, creep, alloy or vessel safety predictions.

interpretation_proposals.A: Residual self-equilibrated stress can make an initially yielding thermal history adapt toward an elastic limiting cycle.
interpretation_proposals.B: A periodic stress history guarantees bounded total strain in a force-controlled perfectly plastic specimen.
interpretation_proposals.C: Accumulated plastic-strain variation can dissipate energy even when each bar net plastic increment over the period is zero.
interpretation_proposals.D: Mechanical work alone accounts for all dissipation when thermal eigenstrains are controlled.
interpretation_proposals.E: An exact contractive cycle map can distinguish asymptotic elastic adaptation from finite-time cessation of plastic flow.
interpretation_proposals.F: Failure of a static elastic adaptation program proves ratcheting for every thermal loading order and history.
interpretation_proposals.G: The separate bars may each be clipped to yield and then allowed to violate total-force equilibrium.
interpretation_proposals.H: All vertex yield signs and residual self-equilibrium must be enforced before a continuous load-domain certificate is valid.

reporting: Use the public answer schema; numerical absolute tolerance1e-7. Bar vectors retain order1,2,3; case arrays retainE,S,A,R; first-two-cycle rows retain chronologicalcycle1,cycle2. High-load static limit is intercept+slope*P on its derived branch. For the exact cycle histories retain signed work/plastic strains as such: they are not probabilities and can be negative. Dissipation, variances and magnitudes cannot be negative. All event identities and infinite-cycle classifications must remain exact; a small step count or small numerical plastic increment is not proof of zero flow. Preserve the actual evolved-state handoffs to registered solves, complete programs and full segment/cycle energy balances.

primary_context.title: Elastic-plastic behaviour of thin tubes subjected to internal pressure and intermittent high-heat fluxes with application to fast-nuclear-reactor fuel elements
primary_context.role: Primary historical context distinguishing thermal plastic cycling, elastic adaptation and ratcheting. The task specifies an unrelated own three-bar triangular-eigenstrain specimen; no tube formula, reactor/vessel model, empirical parameter or source text is copied.
